strings.title: The Frozen Account
strings.hint: Who benefits if the depositor dies before signing the withdrawal papers? Trace who accessed the system using the privileges of a manager on leave.
strings.solvedText:
The culprit: acting branch manager Hani Ezz.

For years, he had embezzled money from a major client, a wealthy elderly man with no direct heirs, through fictitious loans. The client discovered the discrepancy and booked an appointment to withdraw his entire balance and transfer it to another bank. The day before, Hani visited him at home, supposedly to "sign papers," and injected him with fatal insulin, although he was not diabetic, to make the death appear natural. He then accessed the system using the privileges of the regular manager, away on leave, froze the account, and redirected its balance to intermediary accounts.

His access under the absent manager's credentials, the insulin injection mark, and the fictitious loan records the client was about to expose proved his guilt.
strings.summary.text: Wealthy depositor Salem Al-Ghanim was found dead at home on the morning he was due to withdraw his entire fortune from the bank. Death appeared natural for a man in his seventies, but tiny hemorrhagic spots aroused the forensic examiner's suspicion. Analysis revealed fatal insulin in the blood of a man who was not diabetic. At the bank, his account had been frozen at dawn that same day using the privileges of a manager… who was on leave.

strings.scene.intro: No forced entry or disorder: the victim welcomed a visitor he trusted. Partly signed bank papers lie on the table. At the bank, the system log shows a dawn login under the branch manager's privileges, while he was on leave abroad.
strings.scene.photos[0].cap: The latest account statement on the victim's phone

strings.evidence[0].title: System Access Log
strings.evidence[0].desc: Account frozen at 04:15 under the absent branch manager's account while he was abroad. The login came from inside the branch.
strings.evidence[1].title: Insulin Pen
strings.evidence[1].found: Medical waste container near the villa
strings.evidence[1].desc: Wiped, but traces remained inside. From a batch at the pharmacy of the bank's medical unit.
strings.evidence[2].title: Fictitious Loan Record
strings.evidence[2].desc: Loans to nonexistent companies drained the account for years. They were created by the acting manager.
strings.evidence[3].title: Withdrawal Papers
strings.evidence[3].desc: A request to transfer the entire balance to another bank, partly signed. Signing stopped when the visitor arrived.
strings.evidence[4].title: Villa Visitor Log
strings.evidence[4].desc: A car bearing the bank's logo entered the neighborhood at 19:00 and left at 20:10 on the night of the death.
strings.suspects[0].name: Hani Ezz
strings.suspects[0].alibi: "I was at the bank until evening, then at home. My daily routine."
strings.suspects[0].statement: I served Mr. Salem faithfully for years. The loans were investments he approved himself. The dawn system login? Perhaps an error in my temporary privileges while acting as manager. His death is a loss for the bank. Who kills their best client?
strings.suspects[1].name: Walid, the Victim's Nephew
strings.suspects[1].alibi: "I was at a café with my friends until midnight."
strings.suspects[1].statement: My uncle never gave me a penny in his life, and yes, I was angry. But I'm his only heir. If I'd waited, I would have inherited everything legally. Whoever froze his account deprived me of the inheritance itself. What do I gain from his death if the account is empty?
strings.suspects[2].name: Souad, the Home Nurse
strings.suspects[2].relation: Cares for him three times a week
strings.suspects[2].alibi: "I wasn't on duty that night. My schedule proves it."
strings.suspects[2].statement: I look after his blood pressure and medication. He has no insulin because he isn't diabetic. I would have told the investigators that even if they hadn't asked. I loved him like a father, and I wasn't even in the house that night. Whoever injected him knows medicine… or knows someone who can guide them.
strings.witnesses[0].name: House Employee
strings.witnesses[0].statement: Yesterday evening an elegant man from the bank visited with a briefcase. They sat in the study. I heard Mr. Salem raise his voice: "This is my money, and I'm moving it tomorrow." Then the man left alone.
strings.witnesses[1].name: Bank Guard
strings.witnesses[1].statement: The acting manager entered the branch at 04:00, which was completely unusual. He said he had "forgotten an important file." He left half an hour later.
strings.witnesses[2].name: Branch Manager (By Phone)
strings.witnesses[2].statement: I was on leave abroad all week and never accessed the system. My privileges were temporarily delegated to my deputy, Hani. He was the only person able to use them.
strings.folders[0].name: Incident reports
strings.folders[0].docs[0].title: Death Notification
strings.folders[0].docs[0].body: The house employee reported the victim's death. The case became a criminal investigation following the forensic examiner's observations.
strings.folders[1].name: Forensic medicine
strings.folders[1].docs[0].title: Toxicology report
strings.folders[1].docs[0].body: Fatal insulin in a non-diabetic; an injection mark behind the left arm. Death occurred at 22:00–23:00 on the night of the visit.
strings.folders[2].name: Forensic evidence
strings.folders[2].docs[0].title: Insulin Pen Examination
strings.folders[2].docs[0].body: From a batch at the medical unit's pharmacy. A glove impression was found on the outer surface.
strings.folders[2].docs[1].title: System Access Trace Analysis
strings.folders[2].docs[1].body: The dawn login came from a device inside the branch under the absent manager's account. The only person present with his privileges was his deputy.
strings.folders[3].name: Records
strings.folders[3].docs[0].title: Loan Record
strings.folders[3].docs[0].body: A series of loans to fictitious companies drained 60% of the account over four years. Every approval was signed by Hani.
strings.folders[3].docs[1].title: Bank Visit Record
strings.folders[3].docs[1].body: The branch car was recorded in the victim's neighborhood on the night of his death. The driver was the acting manager.
strings.folders[4].name: Confidential files
strings.folders[4].docs[0].title: Trail of the Frozen Funds
strings.folders[4].docs[0].body: After the freeze, the balance was redirected to intermediary accounts indirectly owned by Hani Ezz.
strings.folders[4].docs[1].title: Confrontation Record
strings.folders[4].docs[1].body: Confronted with the login record, the loans, and the money trail, Hani remained silent, then broke down: "He was going to expose everything tomorrow."
strings.reports[0].title: Timing Report
strings.reports[0].author: Investigation team
strings.reports[0].body: Murder hours before withdrawal plus a dawn account freeze: a race against a signature that would expose embezzlement. The only person who benefited from both death and the freeze was the embezzler.
strings.reports[1].title: Heir Report
strings.reports[1].author: Assigned investigator
strings.reports[1].body: The nephew loses through the freeze rather than gains. The direction of the benefit rules him out and points to the banker.
strings.notes[0].text: He died a day before the withdrawal. Who would it have exposed?
strings.notes[1].text: A manager on leave logs in at dawn? Who holds his privileges?
